dedupe_keys.name: sysmo national sweden multimodal activity plans trajectories and road network

description: This SySMo release contains a synthetic Swedish population, daily activity plans, simulated travel trajectories and a road network prepared by Chalmers University of Technology. The team uses 10.2 million agents and runs MATSim in ten randomly divided batches to derive an average weekday of multimodal travel. Source networks use OpenStreetMap from August 2023 and public-transport schedules from September 2023. Zenodo provides twenty-six Parquet and shapefile-component files free under CC BY 4.0. All agents are retained in the population table, but plans and trajectories exclude the twenty-seven percent classified as infeasible because of negative activity times or utility scores. Independent batches and feasibility filtering limit interpretation as a single observed national traffic equilibrium. A reviewer-assessed use is testing transport demand or infrastructure-change scenarios using second-level simulated movement. model-matsim is the documented simulator; data-sweden-synthetic-bev-travel-charging-demand is a distinct regional charging application. No large data files or simulations were downloaded or executed.
